name: kmm-migration
description: Android → Kotlin Multiplatform migration orchestrator at user-chosen scope (whole feature / single module / single screen / single file). Follows JetBrains' canonical migration workflow sourced live from kotlinlang.org per invocation: libs first → business logic → UI, leaf-first within each step. 15 iron laws enforce 1:1 port, surgical changes, codebase-first planning with zero ambiguity, live-sourced technology decisions, and Law 15 — canonical KMP approach over short-term expedience (no hardcoded resources, no inlined JVM-only APIs, no hand-rolled DI, no comments-as-deferrals). Per-file preconditions (resources moved before screens, JVM APIs replaced before logic, deps swapped before code) catch the canonical failure modes. Migrator self-audits via comprehensive checklist BEFORE STATUS: DONE, replacing the previous two-stage reviewer dispatch — saves tokens and time, with a deterministic diff-grep tripwire as orchestrator backstop. Conditional dispatch injection: each subagent's must_read is computed by the orchestrator at dispatch time based on role × phase × in-scope file classification, not pre-baked. Knowledge stays in the docs (the skill ships behaviours and pointers, not version-bound facts that would go stale). Opus orchestrator never edits code — all labour in Sonnet/Haiku subagents. Self-contained — no external skill dependencies.
